hana: Heads-up — tried the JS SDK quickstart on Deno and Bun; ran into multiple small but blocking issues.
tyler: brief list?
hana: 1) Deno throws `package.json exports do not contain ./deno` when using the README default import. 2) TS in Deno complains about default export when we only ship named ESM. 3) Bun (earlier builds) sometimes lacks `crypto.subtle` causing auth sign to fail.
zoe: ack. We should add a deno-specific entrypoint and explicit types for it. Deno tends to prefer named exports.
tyler: agree. Proposed package.json exports snippet: "./deno": "./dist/deno/index.mjs" and keep main import/require for node.
hana: also runtime differences: Bun's fetch response.body stream shape breaks our `instanceof ReadableStream` checks. Quick fallback: try `response.json()` then `response.arrayBuffer()` before raw stream ops.
zoe: for crypto, small adaptive helper: `const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle ?? (await import('./shims/subtle.js')).subtle` — dynamic import only when needed so tree-shaking isn't impacted.
tyler: typings: publish `dist/deno/index.d.ts` and make sure export paths include types for that entry; Deno/TS will pick it up.
hana: CI: add a tiny matrix job that runs examples against node (18), deno (>=1.34), and bun nightly. ci-bot: nightly run failed for deno quickstart: https://ci.internal/quickstarts/342 (shows exports error)
zoe: also update README quickstart to show both: `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'` and `import { Redwood } from 'redwood'` with note about which runtimes support each.
tyler: I'll open a small PR: add `examples/deno-quickstart` (deno.json + import_map.json), add `dist/deno` bundle, and a CI job.
hana: I'll take the subtle fallback + fetch normalizer in runtime-adapters. I'll add unit tests that mock missing `crypto.subtle`.
zoe: I'll adjust package.json exports and add the types entry. Also will add a short compatibility table in README.
ci-bot: created issue #731: "SDK: Deno/Bun compatibility - deno export, runtime adapters, webcrypto shim, fetch normalization" assigned to tyler,hana,zoe.
hana: thanks — want to avoid partner POC blockers from small runtime surprises. :+1:
